final.memo:
Our investment in Yahoo! was built on a dual thesis: a significant gap between realizable parts and core valuation, and a necessary governance intervention [D01]. With the installation of a new CEO and our successful acquisition of board seats, the governance catalyst has been effectively realized [D03]. We have achieved the primary structural change we demanded. 

While we continue to monitor the company's product-launch pace and engagement metrics, the operating fundamentals—specifically revenue ex-TAC and adjusted EBITDA—have not yet demonstrated a clear inflection [D03]. Gains in share price resulting from our involvement should not be mistaken for a proven advertising-margin turnaround [D03]. 

Consistent with our philosophy of exiting when the catalyst is spent, we are trimming our position to lock in gains from the successful governance transition [D07]. We maintain our exposure to the Asian assets, which remain a distinct source of upside, but we are no longer compelled to hold the full core advertising franchise at current valuations without further evidence of operating acceleration [D05]. We prefer to rotate capital into higher-skew events rather than wait indefinitely for operational proof [D05].
